hilfetext: Sample for demonstration. The issuing bank is responsible for the content of a real template. Articles of association, succession clause, notary and tax advisor are in this area under “Block 2 — What keeps the company able to act”, the filing location of the will or inheritance contract under “Legal foundations”.
Year of the planned handover and the next agreed step.
The person who is to take over the business. Their current role in the business goes into the free-text field. If not yet decided: enter “still open”.
Whether one exists, who prepared it, how current it is and where it is kept.
Which agreements exist, which collateral belongs to them, where the documents are kept and who the contact person at the bank is.
Which agreements they cover and what is to happen to them at handover.

feldname: Accounts, powers of attorney and signing authority
hilfetext: Who signs today and what changes at handover. The rules of representation are in the area “Authority and powers of attorney”.
Whether the successor has to finance the takeover and how far talks about it have progressed.
Legal advice, chamber and other contact persons for the handover. Notary and tax advisor are already under “Block 2”.
Records and documents from the talks with the bank, as a document in the folder.
Dates and steps until the handover.
Co-shareholders, managers, family: who is involved in the handover.
Whether the planning for it is in place, where the documents are kept and who advises on it.
